title: Women’s Night Robe
desc: A Turquerie-inspired night robe featuring an original butterfly motif. Made from a lightweight synthetic silk that dries remarkably fast, the robe offers a soft sheen and fluid movement. Its wide sleeves, shorter-than-expected length, and deep neckline create a relaxed yet bold silhouette suitable for both lounging and styling.
notes: Original butterfly-pattern robe inspired by traditional Turkish motifs.
Made from a lightweight synthetic silk designed for quick drying.
Sleeves are intentionally wide, and the overall length is shorter for a lively silhouette.
Neckline is deeply cut, creating an elegant but bold line.
material: Lightweight synthetic silk with a soft, fluid drape and fast-drying performance.
shipping: Orders are prepared and shipped from my studio. Processing and shipping times may vary depending on demand and location.
care: Machine washable. To prevent the inner tie from tangling, place the robe in a washing net. Safe to use in both washing machines and dryers.
